headline: Vercel 24小时扫出6817个漏洞，AI 重写软件时代来了
bullets: Vercel 的 Agent 安全审查 24 小时内找出 6817 个漏洞，其中 580 个高危，1411 个已被自动修复。
Replit 与日本 SMFL 合作，一人一周干完过去六人半年的活，AI 写软件开始进大企业。
swyx 说 thinkymachines 的 inkling 模型蒸馏后快 3 倍、便宜 5 倍，评测还不掉，称它是最被低估的基座模型。
OpenAI 继续招人：Cat Wu 加入负责核心产品 PM，还组了网络安全团队。
builder 们反复在聊：AI 写的软件会又快又安全，人类只负责把关和提需求。
sentiment: 整体兴奋偏震撼，主要对 AI 自动找漏洞、重写软件的能力感到冲击，也有人开始反思工具该帮人思考而不是替人思考。

gave a talk at @aiDotEngineer shanghai about about a question i keep coming back to: when we can make anything, do we still know what we want?

posts.name: Guillermo Rauch
posts.text:
We will all be learning in coming weeks & months, that most human-made software:

▫️ Was really slow
▫️ Had many security vulnerabilities
▫️ Was under-specified and incorrect

AI will rewrite it all. Many times. It will make it fast, cost-efficient, and secure. It will think about failure modes we couldn't wrap our heads around.

It will prove, formally verify, load test, harden. It will turn memory-unsafe foundations into robust, optimized ones. If you ask, it'll thoroughly document it, teach you about it, make diagrams, animations, and slide decks.

In many ways, we are witnessing the true birth of software engineering.
posts.summaryZh: rauchg 预言 AI 会把人类写的软件全部重写多遍：更快、更省、更安全，还能形式验证、压测、加固、写文档，认为这才是软件工程的真正诞生。

posts.name: Cat Wu
posts.text:
Some news: I’m joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products!

I have a lot of respect for OpenAI for showing the world that scaling works, for bringing AI to over a billion people, and for believing great products are core to the mission.

I’m excited to work with @thsottiaux, an incredible PM team, and everyone across OpenAI. Together, we’ll build agents that have your back and your team’s, and keep you in control, so you get more time for the people and work you love.

Lots to learn, and lots to build. Please keep your feedback coming!

As a customer, what I want: one central brain (AI) that can interact with me whether I text it or speak to it, whether I want to buy something or need support, and can actually do something helpful for me (agentic action) - 24/7, always in a good mood, instantly available.

The combination between @dialpad and @ada_cx creates a major new entrant pursuing this big vision.

As an investor since the Series A, excited for @mimurchison and team to go after it.
